svg.title: A ring of zeros lets the window reach the edge
svg.desc: On the left an 8 by 8 grid of pixels with no padding: the rule gives 8 plus 0 minus 3, divided by 1, plus 1, equals 6, and the corner pixel sits inside only 1 window while a middle pixel sits in 9. On the right the same grid with one ring of zeros around it, making 10 by 10: the rule gives 8 plus 2 minus 3, divided by 1, plus 1, equals 8, and the corner pixel now sits inside 4 windows.
svg.text: A ring of zeros lets the window reach the edge
the corner pixel sits in 1 window
the corner pixel now sits in 4 windows
8 in, 8 out · and the corner got four times the hearing it had.
